items.source: since the MergedAnnotations model always ignores lang annotations according to the AnnotationFilter.PLAIN filter, for efficiency reasons
items.translation: 由于出于效率原因，MergedAnnotations 模型始终根据 AnnotationFilter.PLAIN 过滤器忽略 lang 注解。

items.source: AnnotationFilter that matches annotations in the java and javax packages and their subpackages.
items.translation: 匹配 `java` 和 `javax` 包及其子包中注解的AnnotationFilter。

items.source: AnnotationFilter that matches annotations in the java.lang and org.springframework.lang packages and their subpackages.
items.translation: 匹配 `java.lang` 和 `org.springframework.lang` 包及其子包中注解的AnnotationFilter。

items.source: AnnotationFilter that always matches and can be used when no relevant annotation types are expected to be present at all.
items.translation: AnnotationFilter，它始终匹配，可用于预期根本不存在任何相关注解类型的情况。

items.source: Create a new AnnotationFilter that matches annotations in the specified packages.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AnnotationFilter接口，以匹配指定包中的注解。

items.source: Configure the AnnotationFilter to use.
items.translation: 配置要使用的AnnotationFilter。

items.source: Uses of AnnotationFilter in org.springframework.core.annotation
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.core.annotation` 包中 `AnnotationFilter` 的用法

items.source: Create a new MergedAnnotations instance containing all annotations and meta-annotations from the specified element and, depending on the MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy, related inherited elements.
items.translation: 创建一个包含指定元素的所有注解和元注解的新的MergedAnnotations实例，并且根据MergedAnnotations.SearchStrategy，包含相关的继承元素。

items.source: Create a new MergedAnnotations instance from the specified annotations.
items.translation: 从指定的注解创建一个新的MergedAnnotations实例。

items.source:
Core support package for annotations, meta-annotations, and merged
annotations with attribute overrides.
items.translation: 用于注解、元注解以及带有属性覆盖的合并注解的核心支持包。
